scope: One SKU, two locations, one review, 28 demand days and five paid closure days
negative_controls: receipt before dispatch plus transit rejects
partial receipt 5 leaves 7 in transit; final receipt 7 conserves 12
two concurrent 12-piece reservations cannot both consume 23-piece surplus
duplicate identity is idempotent; changed identity payload rejects
future/contradictory/incomplete donor evidence blocks all transfer conclusions
new source basis cannot silently reset previously dispatched donor stock
limits: Declared synthetic demand; no stochastic donor-service guarantee
